selected.title: Firms object to shares being part of OKX-ICE tokenised stock trading venture
selected.summary: A host of companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and Microsoft, have registered their objection to their shares trading on a planned tokenised platform developed by Nyse parent Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX.
selected.why: Major corporations formally object to tokenised stock trading platform, creating significant industry conflict.

reason: Major corporations blocking tokenised stock trading reveals genuine disagreement about whether blockchain improves or threatens market structure and access.
angle: Corporate objections to OKX-ICE tokenised stock platform suggest incumbent gatekeepers fear competition, but the objections may reveal legitimate structural risks that tokenisation doesn't solve.
